matched_rules.label: minor_in_household_no_draft
matched_rules.description: Drafting a triage note is not permitted where the household includes a person under the age of 18. Unlike restricted_actions, this is evaluated from the resident's household composition, not from the referral's requested_action or summary text.

reason: Household includes person(s) under 18: Maria Carver (age 3). Per amendment ACA-2026/2 clause 3.9, no triage note may be drafted for this referral.
agent_action_taken: None. No triage note was drafted or prepared -- amendment ACA-2026/2 clause 3.9 prohibits producing the draft itself, not merely its adoption. This is a hand-off of ordinary casework, not an escalation: see clause 3.3.
